intents.title: Remove the duplicated drift ledger test
intents.statement: test_drift_ledger_persistence is defined twice in turn_flow.rs, which fails the whole integration target with E0428. Keep one definition and delete the other.

intents.title: Port the drift ledger test to the current model
intents.statement: Rewrite the surviving test against DriftLedgerEntry { id, finding_id, file, summary, verdict: String, tolerated_at, review_by, note } instead of the removed { file, verdict: DriftVerdict, entered_at, expires_at } shape.

intents.title: Exercise drift policy tests with auto-adopt enabled
intents.statement: t0072 made drift_auto_adopt default to false, so two end_to_end assertions that expect automatic mapping now describe an opt-in mode. Enable the policy flag explicitly in the drift and rename tests and assert on the specific findings instead of exact counts.
